achievement.bestprogress: Your best result so far is {0} of {1}
achievement.chainsaw.description: Kill 5 units in the same turn with one unit. A Knight is probably the best unit to do this with since it can chain many units in a row.
achievement.chainsaw.title: Chainsaw
achievement.complete.title: Achievement Completed
achievement.completionist.description: Become the greatest Architect of all time by completing all 7 monuments before the turn limit.
achievement.completionist.title: Grand Achitect
achievement.diplomat.description: Have a peace treaty with 100% of your opponents at the same time. Requires the Diplomacy tech and some creative play to make everyone love you.
achievement.diplomat.title: Peace Keeper
achievement.epidemic.description: Perfect the unique Poison ability of the Cymanti tribe until you have 20 enemy units infected at the same time.
achievement.epidemic.title: Epidemic
achievement.fail: {0} failed because you broke the rules.
achievement.fail.title: Achievement Failed!
achievement.farmmaster.description: Create a max level Windmill. Burning forests can be a way to create the crop you need to succeed.
achievement.farmmaster.title: Farm Master
achievement.firedragon.description: Raise 7 Fire Dragons and keep them alive. The ∑∫ỹriȱŋ tribe is the only one who has the ability to raise Dragons, so that is a requirement to succeed.
achievement.firedragon.title: Age of Fire
achievement.frozen.description: Freeze every single tile of the world in a Perfection Game. The Polaris tribe is a requirement since that is the only tribe that has the power to freeze, using their Moonies and Gaamis. Only one Polaris player is allowed.
achievement.frozen.title: Permafrost
achievement.houdini.description: Unsiege a city by making the enemy just disappear into thin air. This is for the Pro players, if you don't know how it is done, consult the mighty Oracle (the internet).
achievement.houdini.title: Houdini
achievement.loveofgod.description: Please all of the Polytopian Gods by building four unique types of temples: Forest Temple, Mountain Temple, Water Temple and a Field Temple (Ice Temple also works if you are Polaris).
achievement.loveofgod.title: Pantheon
achievement.megacity.description: Focus all your effort to make one of your cities reach level 12 before the turn limit.
achievement.megacity.title: Babylon
achievement.monoculture.description: Win a Domination game training only 1 type of unit in your cities. Your starting unit does not count, Giants are allowed but not ship upgrades.
achievement.monoculture.title: Monoculture
achievement.pacifist.description: Win a game without making any attacks. Mind Benders can be used to convert your enemies in a non violent way and it is ok to capture cities as long as you don't hurt anyone.
achievement.pacifist.title: Love & Might
achievement.richie.description: ...or die trying. Have 1000 stars at your disposal before the turn limit. Try to build your economy while also saving up stars each turn (this is tricky).
achievement.richie.title: Get Rich...
achievement.staywet.description: Win a Domination game as the Aquarion tribe without ever touching any land tiles. Remember that the puffer fish can drain land tiles from a distance and that the Crab floods any tile it moves to. Only one Aquarion player is allowed.
achievement.staywet.title: Stay Wet
achievement.woodmaster.description: Create a max level Saw Mill. The Spiritualism tech gives you the ability to plant new forests if the map spawn is not in your favour.
achievement.woodmaster.title: Wood Master

splashscreen.switch.full: Thank you for trying out the demo! Upgrading to the full version will get you:
startmenu.newversion.2.10.0.text: The new reworked version Aquarion is here! They now have mermaids that can rule both land and sea, hang out with Sharks & Jellies and discover lost cities in the ocean.
startmenu.newversion.2.10.0.title: Aquarion Rise Again!
startmenu.newversion.2.11.0.text: Get to know the tragic, abandoned Forgotten! Ride crocodiles, tame toads, and much more. It also brings changes to the Aquarion in general, such as adding speedy Bubbles.
startmenu.newversion.2.11.0.title: The new Aquarion skin is here!
startmenu.newversion.2.12.0.text: Repeatable single-player games where everyone uses the same seed and settings! There will be a challenge every week, so now you have a new way to show the world your Polytopia-skills!
startmenu.newversion.2.12.0.title: Introducing Weekly Challenges!
startmenu.newversion.2.13.0.text: The Solaris start the game with the ability to turn water into solid lava and petrify enemies into ash. Master Heatwork, Osteophagy, Geothermics, Magmatism, Explosives, and much more.
startmenu.newversion.2.13.0.title: Burn the Square to ashes with the new Polaris skin!
startmenu.newversion.2.13.2.text: We made some tweaks to make the tribes be more equal when battling each other, tap to read the full change log!
startmenu.newversion.2.13.2.title: Balance Pass
startmenu.newversion.2.15.0.text: The rework of the Cymanti tribe just dropped with a bunch of new units and mechanics! Read the full story on our blog.
startmenu.newversion.2.15.0.title: Cymanti Rework
startmenu.newversion.2.15.2.text: Who will lift the 2025 Polytopia World Championship Trophy? December 6th live on stage in Stockholm with expert commentators.
startmenu.newversion.2.16.0.text: Master botanics with the new Cymanti Skin!
startmenu.newversion.2.16.0.title: Meet Claude, Squishy, Eggy, Fairy, and other adorable creatures. Practice gardening, learn mindfulness, grow odd toxins, and much more.
startmenu.newversion.2.18.0.text: We added a bunch of Achievements to Polytopia. Win a game without making any attacks, get a level 12 city and many other challenges. Learn more in the “Throne Room”.
startmenu.newversion.2.18.0.title: Achievements!
startmenu.newversion.2.8.0.text: This version of Polytopia introduces a whole new way of playing on the ocean! New types of ships, buildings and other fun stuff. Learn more on our official launch post.
startmenu.newversion.2.8.0.title: startmenu.newversion.2.8.0.title
startmenu.newversion.2.8.5.text: This patch aims to simplify and improve the Naval Rework that we released a few months ago. Markets are now easier to use, Aqua Crops are gone, bridges are cheaper plus a lot more. Check out the full change log for more info.
startmenu.newversion.2.8.5.title: Patch of the Ocean
startmenu.newversion.2.9.0.text: The new, special ₼idŋighţ skin for ∑∫ỹriȱŋ allows you to create graves, build crypts, and summon demons from the graves in the dark forests. Learn more in our official launch post.
startmenu.newversion.2.9.0.title: The brand new ∑∫ỹriȱŋ skin is here!

tooltip.ability.autofreeze: This unit freezes any surrounding tiles and units when moving.
tooltip.ability.autofreeze_magma: This unit burns any surrounding tiles and units when moving.
tooltip.ability.boost: Give surrounding friendly units a temporary boost in attack and speed.
tooltip.ability.bubble: Spawns a bubble around any amphibious unit that moves to a flooded tile. The bubble gives a speed boost until the unit is attacked or moves onto land
tooltip.ability.capitalvision: Reveals the capital of all tribes you encounter.

tooltip.ability.convert: This unit can convert an enemy to your own tribe by attacking it.
tooltip.ability.creep: This unit does not get any movement penalties in rough terrain except mountains.
tooltip.ability.dash: This unit can attack after moving if there is an enemy in range.
tooltip.ability.decompose: Decompose any building within your borders and get its full cost in stars back at the end of the turn.
tooltip.ability.destroy: Remove any building within your borders, great for reconstructing your empire.

tooltip.ability.disband: Remove any of your own units and get half of its cost in return.
tooltip.ability.discipline: Units become veterans after 2 kills instead of 3
tooltip.ability.disloyal: This unit switches side to the previous ruler when the area they are in is captured

tooltip.ability.escape: This unit can move again after attacking.
tooltip.ability.explode: Make your units explode inflicting poison and collateral damage to surrounding enemies.
tooltip.ability.fly: This unit can fly over any terrain with no movement penalties or bonuses.
tooltip.ability.fortify: This unit gets a defense bonus when defending in its own cities, double bonus with a city wall.
tooltip.ability.freeze: This unit freezes its enemies when attacking them so they cannot move.
tooltip.ability.freeze_magma: This unit petrifies its enemies when attacking them so they cannot move.
tooltip.ability.freezearea: This unit can freeze the surrounding tiles including any enemy units.
tooltip.ability.freezearea_magma: This unit can burn the surrounding tiles and petrify enemy units.
tooltip.ability.glide: All non-skating units get an extra move when moving on ice.
tooltip.ability.glide_magma: All non-rolling units get an extra move when moving on lava.
tooltip.ability.grow: This unit will eventually grow and become something else.
tooltip.ability.heal: This unit can heal surrounding units.
tooltip.ability.hide: This unit hides when it moves, becoming invisible to the enemy.
tooltip.ability.independent: This unit does not require any support from its home city.

tooltip.ability.literacy: Reduce the price of all technologies by {0}%.
tooltip.ability.microbes: All your Fungi can grow one additional level
tooltip.ability.microbes_cute: All your Flowers can grow one additional level
tooltip.ability.navigate: This unit can move in any terrain even if you do not have the tech needed to move there.
tooltip.ability.peacetreaty:

You find this function in the 'Tribe Info Screen', select the name of a tribe to get there.
tooltip.ability.persist: This unit can keep attacking as long as it completely kills its victims.
tooltip.ability.poison: Inflicts poison to enemies when attacking. Poisoned units get reduced defense and movement. They also spread spores when they die.
tooltip.ability.poison_old: Inflicts poison to enemies when attacking. Poisoned units get reduced defense & also spread spores when they die.
tooltip.ability.pontoon: Land improvements can be built on water.
tooltip.ability.scout: This unit has double vision range.
tooltip.ability.skate: This unit gets their movement limited to 1 tile and all other abilities disabled when on land.
tooltip.ability.skate_magma: This unit gets their movement limited to 1 tile and all other abilities disabled when on land.

tribepicker.categories.specialtribes.des: A collection of tribes that are a bit out of this world...
tribepicker.disabled.description: Tribe disabled, it cannot be used by you or the AI.
tribepicker.firstplayer: First player must be a human
tribepicker.freetribe.description: This tribe is available for free and cannot be purchased to enable online multiplayer.
tribepicker.title: PICK YOUR TRIBE
tribepicker.underconstruction.descriptio: We are still working on inventing this tribe. Growing fruits, developing languages and architecture. That takes time you know. Follow @Midjiwan on Instagram or Twitter and you will be the first to know when new tribes arrive!
tribes.aimo.info: The tranquil and wise {0} tribe inhabits the harshest, windiest and highest mountain range of the square, where they have found inner peace by meditating in the eternal evening light.
tribes.aimo.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.aimo.info_aibo: The To-Lï rigorously train their bodies and minds in the sturdy Binba forests, and are here to show their strength and discipline to the Square.
tribes.aquarion.info: From the deep oceans, a long-lost civilization appears! During their time in isolation they have developed mermaid tails that makes it possible for them to move freely in water.
tribes.aquarion.info2: {0} start with the ability to construct land buildings on the water and their naturally flooded terrain provide movement for both land and aquatic units.
tribes.aquarion.info2_swamp: The Forgotten can befriend swampy fauna, build structures on the water, revive old Aquarion outposts, and swim effortlessly in their marshy terrain.
tribes.aquarion.info_swamp: When the original Aquarion sank beneath the waves eons ago, the Forgotten were left on this swampy atoll. Over time they have adapted to the moist climate and grown squid legs.
tribes.bardur.info: Surviving the harsh eternal winter of the {0} woods is not an easy task, but {0} seems to thrive here.
tribes.bardur.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.bardur.info_baerion: The Baergøff are the Bardur’s elite hunters. Clad in the sanctified pelt of their first Baerion kill, they’re ready for anything!
tribes.cymanti.info: The {0} are a breakout group of Polytopians who moved to the swampy forests and learned to live with the Ciru Bug, which attaches to their faces and merges with their brains.
tribes.cymanti.info2: Led by their Shaman, the {0} train gigantic bugs, use their enemies to fertilize their fungi farms and utilize crippling poisons to vanquish all who would threaten their marshy home!
tribes.cymanti.info_cute: Cymanti geneticists of the New Dawn Movement evolved these new, cuter appearances to ensure the lasting future of the swarm.
tribes.elyrion.info: The mysterious {0} defend their woodland homes with colorful magic and the ferocity of fire-breathing dragons!
tribes.elyrion.info2: They regard Nature as a holy spirit and cannot hunt animals or chop down trees, instead they start the game with the unique Enchantment tech that can turn regular animals into powerful monsters.
tribes.elyrion.info2_darkelf: Through necromancing practices they can summon demons from graves in the dark forests.
tribes.elyrion.info_darkelf: The ₼idŋighţ cult has been corrupted by the Shard of D’Naeh, a mystical relic fueled by darkness.
tribes.hoodrick.info: The yellow autumn leaves of the {0} woods are perfect hideouts for its peculiar mushroom stuffing inhabitants.
tribes.hoodrick.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.hoodrick.info_ranger: Bands of the Hoodrick’s finest sharpshooters and survivalists, the Yorthwober know their way around combat just as well as they do the hills and forests.
tribes.imperius.info: Huge mountains and green valleys. The {0} climate is perfect for growing fruit.
tribes.imperius.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.imperius.info_scholar: The scholarly Lirepacci have ventured out of Imperia to gain new perspectives on life through warfare, the study of other cultures, and hours of philosophical debate.
tribes.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech and {2} stars.
tribes.info2_aquarion: {0} start with the ability to construct land buildings on the water and their naturally flooded terrain provide movement for both land and aquatic units.
tribes.info2_capital: {0} starts the game with a huge capital and {2} stars.
tribes.info2_cute: Led by a Guru, this sect breeds hordes of adorable insects, colorful flowers, and funky toxins to dispatch their foes as they attempt to usher in a new age for the Cymanti!
tribes.info2_cymanti: Led by their Shaman, the {0} train gigantic bugs, use their enemies to fertilize their fungi farms and utilize crippling poisons to vanquish all who would threaten their marshy home!
tribes.info2_darkelf: Through necromancing practices they can summon demons from graves in the dark forests.
tribes.info2_elyrion: They regard Nature as a holy spirit and cannot hunt animals or chop down trees, instead they start the game with the unique Enchantment tech that can turn regular animals into powerful monsters.
tribes.info2_magma: Solaris starts the game with the ability to burn surrounding terrain and turn water into solid lava
tribes.info2_polaris: {0} starts the game with the ability to freeze surrounding terrain using Moonies.
tribes.info2_swamp: The Forgotten can befriend swampy fauna, build structures on the water, revive old Aquarion outposts, and swim effortlessly in their marshy terrain.
tribes.kickoo.info: White sandy beaches with coconut palms. Abundance of fruit and fish. Welcome to the home of the {0}.
tribes.kickoo.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.kickoo.info_pirate: The scourge of the waters, the bane of navies, the serpents of the seas - The Ragoo Pirates! Their fleets of ships and lust for plunder are ready to expand their operations from the Kickoo Isles to the rest of the Square!
tribes.luxidoor.info:
The {0} love expensive things, jewels, rare spices and exclusive ornaments. That is also why they are the most expensive tribe in Polytopia!

Their citizens lead very comfortable lives, draped in the finest purple silk. But will they survive outside of their beloved capital?
tribes.luxidoor.info2: {0} starts the game with a huge capital.
tribes.luxidoor.info_mercenary: The Aumux Mercenaries are ruthless, effective, and more than willing to destroy their foes, desolate the land, and empty the treasury of their employers in their insatiable, all-consuming greed.
tribes.oumaji.info: The seemingly endless, sun blessed desert is the home of the {0} tribe.
tribes.oumaji.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.oumaji.info_sfinx: This ancient order of Khondor Honor Guards has been around for ages, and they’re here to return the Oumaji to a more “civilized” time.
tribes.polaris.info:
The {0} have lain trapped in the far reaches of the freezing tundra for eons, but were blessed by the unknowable Gaami with the power to expand their unnatural icy terrain farther than the weather permits. 

With the might of sleds and Mamoos, the mystical {0} are determined to entomb the Square in ice and transform the land into a frigid paradise.
tribes.polaris.info2: {0} starts the game with the ability to freeze surrounding terrain using Moonies.
tribes.polaris.info2_magma: Solaris starts the game with the ability to burn surrounding terrain and turn water into solid lava
tribes.polaris.info_magma: A sudden eruption has surfaced the Solaris from their deep mountain caves. Led by the mighty Ralmi they are determined to burn every inch of the Square into ashes.
tribes.quetzali.info: The {0} tribe worship the Bird Gods of the red soil and live in harmony with the natural symmetry of their cubistic jungles. They are commonly seen riding huge flightless birds.
tribes.quetzali.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.quetzali.info_ikarus: Some Quetzali have taken their devotion to the Bird Gods to new heights as they try to transform themselves into actual birds. They look pretty, but unfortunately, they cannot fly.
tribes.vengir.info: Frowned upon by the other tribes and pushed into the unpleasant wastelands. Will they tolerate this injustice or rise to fight back?
tribes.vengir.info2: {0} start the game with the '{1}' tech and a powerful Swordsman.
tribes.vengir.info_skeleton: Fanatical Vengir Cultists devoted to Burzgor shrug off their flesh in the harrowing Thdkrkr Ritual to show their dedication to revenge.
tribes.xinxi.info: They start their journey in the dense mountains, surrounded by beautiful cherry blossoms.
tribes.xinxi.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.xinxi.info_ninja: In the misty hills around Mt. Xin-xi resides the Sha-po, a secretive legion of assassins trained in the arts of dealing a silent death to anyone who opposes the Xin-xi Empire.
tribes.yadakk.info: The {0} started out as a nomadic tribe in the beautiful harsh Khalee plains. Now they are the traders of the Square, connecting their empire with impressive trade routes.
tribes.yadakk.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.yadakk.info_urkaz: The gruff Ürkaz from the Khalee Highlands control the criminal underground of the Yădakk, and nothing is off limits as they establish economic dominance of the Square!
tribes.zebasi.info: {0} thrive on the warm savannah, cultivating the rich soil to provide food for their mighty population.
tribes.zebasi.info2: {0} starts the game with the '{1}' tech.
tribes.zebasi.info_arty: The disciples of Anzala prefer the ways of art and expression over the scientific curiosity of their Zebasi siblings, and now they’re here, with the Square as their canvas!
tribes.zebasi.news: All profits from the Zebasi tribe is invested in solar energy projects.
tutorial.completed.description:
You have now mastered the basic skills to play Polytopia, but there is so much more to discover!
Finish this game by getting the highest possible score before the time runs out.
tutorial.completed.title: Boot Camp Completed!
tutorial.suggestion.description: Someone is hiding here in the clouds...
tutorial.task.capturevillage: Move your unit to a village and capture it.
tutorial.task.capturevillage.description:
Select your unit in the city. The blue markers that appear on the map are places the unit can move to this turn.
After moving the unit you need to end your turn for it to be able to move again.
tutorial.task.capturevillage.title: Move a Unit
tutorial.task.endTurn: A good first round! End your turn to give your unit new energy.
tutorial.task.endTurn.description: Select the 'End Turn' button to give new energy to your units and collect more stars.
tutorial.task.endTurn.title: End Turn
tutorial.task.harvestfruit: Harvest fruit to grow your city!
tutorial.task.harvestfruit.description: Select a fruit tile within the borders of your city and select the 'Harvest Fruit' option. By extracting resources within your borders you can level up your city.
tutorial.task.harvestfruit.title: Grow your city
tutorial.task.meetTribe: There is another tribe hiding somewhere on the Square. See if you can find them!
tutorial.task.meetTribe.description: You are not alone! There are other tribes in this game too and they also try to expand their empires as much as possible. That often leads to conflicts so keep an eye out for your opponents.
tutorial.task.meetTribe.title: Other Tribes
tutorial.task.trainunit: Train a warrior so we can capture that village.
tutorial.task.trainunit.description: Select on your city and select the unit you want to train. Units can be used to explore the map, capture villages and fight your opponents.
tutorial.task.trainunit.title: Training units
tutorial.task.unlockTech: Wild animals can be hunted to grow your city even more. Let's research how to hunt!
tutorial.task.unlockTech.description: Select the 'Tech Tree' button and the pick the 'Hunting' technology. Now you can hunt wild animals to level up your cities!
tutorial.task.unlockTech.title: Tech tree
updateavatar.description: Press the avatar to give birth to a new wild creation
